## Description

Adopt OWASP ASVS L2 as the checklist (docs/compliance/asvs-l2.md with status per control). Implement strict CSP (no inline scripts), HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; ASP.NET Core rate limiting on sign-in, OTP, invite acceptance and search; FluentValidation pipeline on every command; request size limits; antiforgery on state-changing BFF calls.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Security headers score A on an automated header check against staging.
- [ ] **AC2.** Sign-in/OTP endpoints return 429 after the configured threshold per IP and per account.
- [ ] **AC3.** A command without a validator fails an architecture test.
- [ ] **AC4.** ASVS L2 checklist exists with each control marked Done/Planned(phase)/N/A and is reviewed in the R0 gate.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
